player_prompt.intro:
Uri Muhari {player_id} mukati me bhora reReverse Tic Tac Toe. Chishongo chako ndi '{symbol}'.
Chinangwa ndicho kuepika kupata tatu mukati me safu (pamusoro, pasi, kana kwa mshazari).
Kana ukaita tatu mukati me safu, unorasa.
Tumira zvitendo zvako zvakanyorwa kwa mfumo wa '[4]' kuti uzvigire chishongo chako mukati me cela 4.
Senge Muhari {player_id}, uri '{symbol}' na uyo anokurwisa ndiye '{opponent_symbol}'.
